title: Personal Loans Refinance Pricing Memo: Credit for a Credit Builder Account
content:
## Rule

A Credit Builder credit comes off the refinance fee percent of a Personal Loans refinance application: a Credit Builder account of the borrower that reached matured status earns 0.25 point; with no matured account, a Credit Builder account in active status with an amount past due of 0.00 earns 0.1 point; a borrower with neither earns no Credit Builder credit. Any one account meeting a tier's terms is enough for that tier. A borrower holds at most one Credit Builder account in active status, and its amount past due is compared as an amount, so 0, 0.0 and 0.00 are all nothing past due.

The accounts are the borrower's Credit Builder Accounts; their status and amount past due are read from the borrower's Credit Builder records. The refinance fee percent, with this credit taken off, never goes below zero.

| Borrower's Credit Builder Accounts | Credit |
|---|---|
| at least one matured account | 0.25 point |
| no matured account; an active account with nothing past due | 0.10 point |
| no matured account; the active account has an amount past due | none |
| only accounts closed early, closed for delinquency or cancelled, or none | none |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- One matured account and one active account 12.00 USD past due: the matured account is enough: 0.25 point.
- One active account showing 0.0 past due: nothing past due: 0.10 point.
